pr.title: fix(ci): gate full RTE and auditor-router suites
pr.body:
## Problem
CI currently gates only a focused extractor smoke subset and does not gate tests/auditor_router.

## Fix
Make the full RTE suite fail the PR CI lane on regressions and add an auditor-router test job.

## Test Plan
- Validate Task Packet JSON and schema.
- Run tests/auditor_router.
- Run services/repo-truth-extractor/tests.
- Run git diff --check and pre-commit on changed files.
